name: Mathematics I
short: Calculus, matrices and complex numbers — the algebra engine of first-year engineering.
previousYearQuestions: Using Maclaurin's theorem, expand tan x up to the term in x⁵.
Find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a given 3×3 matrix.
studyGuide: Do every problem twice: once in class, once from memory the same evening. Maths marks in IOE exams are won by speed, which only practice builds.
